newsitem.title: USA: North American bunker ease with sellers and NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: North American bunker ease with sellers and NYMEX.

text.p: North American bunker prices mostly fell since last week as buyers returned to a market correcting downward in sympathy with the NYMEX, traders said.

"We've got more players with barrels so we've got more sellers," said one East Coast player, noting deals on 380 CST barrels in New York were done Tuesday at $106 and $107 a tonne -- about $8 a tonne less than last week.

Traders said of particular interest was the way marine diesel prices were fetching a premium to diesel in New York and Houston -- noteworthy since MDO is a lower quality product than diesel in terms of viscosity, density and sulphur.

They said MDO, priced at about $210 a tonne in New York and around $228 a tonne in Houston, was as much as $15 a tonne more than diesel in the respective markets. They cited a lack of efficiency in MDO market as the reason behind the prices.
Bunker prices in Houston and in Los Angeles were lower for the same reasons as in New York, but prices in Seattle were holding onto recent firm levels amid continuing tightness.
-- Oliver Ludwig New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1633
